name: Urolithin A
short: Short trials (up to 4 months) in older and healthy adults report it was well tolerated; adverse events did not differ from placebo in a 66-person trial, and unrelated events were mild or moderate.
text: In a first-in-human trial in healthy, sedentary elderly people given urolithin A by mouth as a single dose or for 4 weeks, the authors reported a favourable safety profile. In a 4-month double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 66 adults aged 65 to 90 taking 1000 mg daily by mouth, no statistical differences in adverse events were observed between the urolithin A and placebo groups, and the authors concluded it was safe and well tolerated. A systematic review of five studies in 250 healthy individuals, lasting 28 days to 4 months, reported that unrelated adverse events were mild or moderate. Longer-term safety data were not found in the cited sources. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
